disambiguation: Not a note-taking tool; it is a gamified companion designed to encourage good note-taking habits.
extras: Desktop only; notes are only read, never stored or sent anywhere.
intentEvidence: A pixel cat that lives at the bottom of your vault, helps you build good note habits and grows every time you write.
problem: Users struggle to maintain consistent note-taking habits and productivity within Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Kit Commit is the free desktop edition of the same cat for Windows and Mac.

summary: A pixel cat desktop pet that gamifies note-taking by rewarding writing, completing tasks, and focusing sessions with XP and coins.
